correctness.rationale: The exact Stirling partition expansion [Adelberg--Lengyel equations (5.2),(5.4)] has unique 2-adically lowest term corresponding to u_1=r=n-k: v2(i+1)<i for i>1. With q=2^h, k=bq+a, B=q-a, T=(c-b-1)q, Kummer yields constant t_b=v2 binom(2c-b-1,c) for T<=d<=r. For d<T, v2 Lambda <=(r+d)/2 implies r-v2 Lambda >=(B+1)/2 > t_b under B>=2t_b, so no cancellation of the leading term. Legendre gives v2 S(cq,k)=s2(a)+s2(b)-s2(c)+t_b. Counting excluded block endpoints and B<2t_b gives E(c) independent of h. The positive index k=cq works; k=0 has undefined ordinary valuation. Independently computed 1881 sufficient-range exact recurrences of 2052 finite examples, and inspected packaged verify.py partition check and modular range; no finite-to-infinite inference.
